buttons.secondary: bg-white text-stone-950 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-light text-stone-950
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-stone-950

layout_and_spacing.card: p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white
layout_and_spacing.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8

components.header: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200. Clear navigation links, brand logo, and primary CTA.
components.buttons: Subtly rounded (rounded-lg or rounded-xl) with hover transformations (scale or lift) and clear contrast.
components.file_upload: Dashed border area (border-2 border-dashed border-stone-300) with hover state (border-stone-400 bg-stone-50). Include an icon and clear instructions.
components.workspace_layout: A split layout for the AI Design tool: A sticky sidebar (w-80 or w-96) on desktop for controls (upload room, upload tiles, mapping), and a large main area for the image preview and visualization.
components.before_after_slider: Interactive comparison component for showing original room vs AI generated room. Requires absolute positioning, object-cover for images, and a draggable slider handle.
components.cards: Subtle border (border-stone-200), no heavy shadow by default, hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300.

interactive_elements.hover_states: All interactable elements must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-stone-50 for secondary buttons, hover:bg-stone-800 for primary).
interactive_elements.focus_states: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-stone-950 for accessibility on inputs and buttons.
interactive_elements.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, input, link, and interactive widget MUST have a descriptive kebab-case data-testid (e.g., `data-testid="upload-room-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Modify Shadcn components to match the minimalist, premium design.
Implement the navigation bar with links: Home, AI Design, My Tiles, My Designs, Showroom, Profile.
Build a robust 'AI Design' workspace. This should include an area selector, room photo uploader, and multiple tile photo uploaders.

MOCK the AI visualization flow. When 'Generate' is clicked, show a sophisticated loading state (e.g., 'Analyzing room perspective...', 'Mapping surfaces...') and then display the Before/After slider using placeholder/mocked result images.
Implement 'My Tile Collection' as a beautiful grid/catalog view where users can see saved tiles (Image, Name, Category, Size).
Implement 'Showroom Mode' designed for professionals to demo to clients, containing tools to save, share via WhatsApp, etc.
Ensure generous spacing (p-8, p-12) and avoid cramped UIs. The app should feel like a premium interior design tool.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for floating elements, dropdowns, or sticky headers. Use solid or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur).
Use Lucide icons for all iconography.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Create a distinctive, high-end feel using the specified typography and color palette.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft, diffuse shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) where appropriate, especially headers and floating toolbars.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target specific properties to prevent breaking transforms.
Do not center align the root app container. Maintain natural left-aligned reading flows.
Use modern button styles (rounded-lg or rounded-full) with interaction animations (e.g., scale down on active).
Never use emoji characters for icons.
Add micro-animations for hover states on cards, buttons, and list items.
